ug_subtitle: Manage Your Financial Freedom - Step by Step Guide
ug_intro_desc: E-Wallet is a comprehensive web application designed for your personal financial management. It allows you to track your income, expenses, investments, and assets all in one place.
ug_intro_purpose: Main Purpose: View your financial status in real-time and make informed decisions for your future.
ug_step_1_desc: Log in to the system with your username and password. If you're using it for the first time, you can get account information from your system administrator.
ug_step_2_desc: After logging in, on the homepage (Cash Flow), you will see your current cash status, 7-day and monthly forecasts.
ug_step_3_desc: Click the Quick Transaction button from the left menu to record your first income or expense. This forms the foundation of the system.
ug_step_4_desc: Edit your income and expense categories from the Categories page. This will make your reports more meaningful.
ug_transactions_desc: Transaction management is the basic module for recording your income and expenses.
ug_tx_income_desc: Your cash inflows such as salary, bonus, rental income, interest.
ug_tx_expense_desc: Your cash outflows such as rent, bills, shopping, food.
ug_tx_investment_desc: Asset purchases such as stocks, gold, crypto.
ug_tx_add_1: Click the Quick Transaction button from the left menu
ug_tx_add_4: Select a category or create a new one
ug_planned_desc: You can create planned transactions for your regularly recurring transactions. For example: monthly rent, loan installment, salary.
ug_planned_tip: Tip: Planned transactions are automatically shown in the payment calendar and calculate your estimated cash flow.
ug_planned_create_1: Click the Add Regular Transaction button from the left menu
ug_planned_create_3: Select the repetition frequency (Monthly, Weekly, etc.)
ug_assets_desc: With the asset management module, you can track your investments and update their values based on market data.
ug_assets_add_1: Go to the Asset Management page
ug_dashboard_desc: On dashboard pages, you can analyze your financial status from different perspectives.
ug_dash_cash_flow_desc: Current cash, 7-day and monthly forecasts. Recent transactions table.
ug_dash_dashboard_desc: Monthly income-expense comparison, category-based distribution charts.
ug_dash_health_desc: Your financial health score, savings rate, debt/income ratio and other metrics.
ug_dash_market_desc: Live market data, exchange rates, gold prices.
ug_calendar_desc: The payment calendar allows you to track your planned transactions and upcoming payments.
ug_calendar_feature_4: Hover over the day to see details
ug_strategy_desc: The strategy center provides analyses and recommendations to help you reach your financial goals.
ug_strategy_freedom_desc: Calculates the time and savings rate needed to reach your financial freedom goal.
ug_faq_1_a: Anyone who wants to manage personal finances can use it. It is especially ideal for individuals with regular income and expenses who want to track their investments.
ug_faq_2_a: Yes, all your data is stored in a local database. Your password is known only to you and CSRF protection is used for session security.
ug_faq_3_a: These are regularly recurring transactions (e.g., monthly rent, loan installment). Planned transactions are automatically shown in the payment calendar and calculate your cash flow forecasts.
ug_faq_4_a: The system automatically updates asset values using live market data. You can also update them manually.
ug_faq_5_a: You can download weekly or monthly PDF reports from the payment calendar page. You can also save by taking screenshots.
ug_faq_6_q: Do I need technical knowledge to use the system?
ug_faq_6_a: No, the system is designed to be user-friendly. Basic computer usage is sufficient. You can easily use it by following this guide.
ug_faq_7_q: Can multiple users use the same system?
ug_faq_7_a: Yes, the system supports multiple users. Each user has their own account and data.
ug_faq_8_a: Yes, you can change your language preference from the Settings page. Turkish, English, German and Italian languages are supported.
ug_contact_desc: If you have questions after reading this guide, you can contact your system administrator.
ug_education_desc: Comprehensive learning guide to improve your financial literacy. 18 different financial topics from beginner to expert level.
ug_education_levels: 4 Education Levels: Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced, and Expert
ug_education_beginner_desc: Learn financial fundamentals. Income-expense management, compound interest, assets, and financial freedom basics.
ug_education_intermediate_desc: Investment strategies and risk management. Portfolio optimization, behavioral finance, and tax planning.
ug_education_advanced_desc: Complex financial instruments. Derivatives, alternative investments, quantitative finance, and algorithmic trading.
ug_education_expert_desc: Advanced financial analysis. Machine learning, blockchain crypto, ESG investing, and expert strategies.
ug_education_feature_1: 4 language support: Turkish, English, German, Italian
ug_education_feature_2: Detailed concept definitions and practical examples for each level
ug_education_feature_3: Mathematical formulas and Python function references
ug_education_feature_4: Expanded technical terms dictionary (3x more explanations)
ug_education_feature_5: Program calculations and analyses with purpose and benefit explanations

ug2_fund_import_desc: The Fund Laboratory accepts timestamped observations through a controlled file flow without fabricating NAV or returns. Imported data appears in the nowcast view with coverage and freshness information.
ug2_fund_import_source_desc: No live scraper is used. Upload a CSV, XLSX, or XLSM file from an official or licensed source while preserving the source name and observation dates.
ug2_fund_import_schema_desc: Required columns are fund_code, as_of_date, and nav. Turkish headers are also recognized; daily_return, available_time, event_time, and published_time improve point-in-time ordering when supplied.
ug2_fund_import_quality_desc: Future dates, zero or negative NAV, invalid risk values, invalid time ordering, and duplicate rows within the same source are rejected. A failed validation atomically rolls back the import.
ug2_fund_import_usage_desc: In Strategy Center > Fund Laboratory, select the file and review the accepted-row and freshness summary. Uploading the same file again does not create new records.
ug2_fund_import_warning_desc: The presence of observations alone does not publish a forecast. A nowcast is meaningful only after sufficient point-in-time data, validation, and model gates are ready; the screen is not investment advice.
ug2_workflow_desc: Manage records in the sequence below for reliable reporting. This workflow combines daily entry with period-end control.
ug2_workflow_step_1_desc: Set the language, base currency, theme and privacy mode in Settings, then verify that user preferences are persisted.
ug2_workflow_step_2_desc: Keep standard categories protected while updating monthly budget limits, and classify custom categories as income, expense or investment.
ug2_workflow_step_3_desc: Check the date, type, category, amount and status before creating an income, expense, investment or transfer record.
ug2_workflow_step_4_title: Create plans from a start date
ug2_workflow_step_4_desc: Define the start date and recurrence rule explicitly for recurring income, subscriptions, periodic payments, installments or DCA plans.
ug2_workflow_step_5_desc: Manage asset positions separately and review cost, quantity, price and value changes to keep portfolio views current.
ug2_workflow_step_6_desc: Compare records with the bank statement, review pending items and export a backup before important changes.
ug2_planned_semantics_desc: A plan is the rule for an expected future event; a completed transaction is a financial record written to the ledger. Reports keep completed records and pending plan occurrences separate.
ug2_planned_start_date_title: How does the start date work?
ug2_planned_start_date_desc: The first occurrence is never moved before the start date. Monthly recurrence is calculated from the start month; a plan starting today does not create records for earlier months.
ug2_planned_occurrence_desc: Each plan occurrence has its own state. Editing a plan affects future occurrences; completed immutable ledger records are not silently rewritten.
ug2_planned_types_title: When should each plan type be used?
ug2_planned_types_desc: Subscriptions and periodic payments are recurring expenses; installments split a liability into fixed parts; DCA is a regular purchase rule for an investment goal.
ug2_controls_desc: For financial accuracy, check the source, status, tenant boundary and ledger movement together instead of relying only on a displayed total.
ug2_controls_categories_desc: Standard categories keep their core definitions and cannot be deleted. Only the monthly budget limit can change; custom categories remain tenant-scoped.
ug2_controls_reconciliation_desc: Enter the statement balance and compare book balance, variance, pending items and the issue list. Transfers are treated as neutral movements.
ug2_controls_ledger_desc: Completed financial records retain an audit trail. Use an adjustment or reversal flow for an error instead of silently updating history.
ug2_controls_import_export_desc: Export before importing. Import is atomic; if validation fails, the operation is rolled back and existing financial data is preserved.
ug2_settings_desc: Personal preferences stay consistent across sessions for the same account. Refresh the page after a change to verify that all screens use the new preference.
ug2_settings_language_desc: Select Turkish, English, Deutsch or Italiano under Settings > Language & Appearance. The choice is written to the session and user preference and survives the next login.
ug2_settings_theme_desc: Choose light, dark or system theme. Light is the default on first launch; a saved user preference is applied on later screens.
ug2_settings_privacy_desc: Privacy mode masks amounts and sensitive summaries and uses the same central preference in the header and Settings.
ug2_settings_backup_desc: Use Settings > Data & Backups to export JSON, store it safely and review the scope before restoring.
ug2_settings_special_code_desc: A user redeeming emincetin10 receives the same full capability model as the emin account. Privileged features such as Monitoring and extended data upload open only after capability checks pass.
ug2_monitoring_desc: Monitoring brings system health, quick statistics, log files, error signals, security events and the real-time SSE stream into one workspace.
ug2_monitoring_access_desc: Monitoring endpoints are protected by capabilities. Without access, the screen or API returns a login/access redirect; this is expected security behavior.
ug2_monitoring_upload_desc: Upload local logs only within supported format and size limits. Narrow results with search, level filters and the timeline; redact sensitive values before sharing.
ug2_monitoring_sse_desc: The SSE connection updates new log events live. If it drops, the client reconnects in a controlled way; historical records still come from the normal API query.

ug2_last_updated: This guide reflects the current application flows and security rules.
ug2_faq_9_q: I changed the language; why did some text not change?
ug2_faq_9_a: Refresh the page first. If a user-visible string remains unchanged, report the screen and text for an i18n parity check; new text must use the same key across all four catalogs.
ug2_faq_10_q: Why did my plan not create an occurrence before its start date?
ug2_faq_10_a: The system never creates the first occurrence before the start date. Monthly recurrence starts from the start month, so a plan beginning today does not backfill earlier months.
ug2_faq_11_q: How do I reconcile multiple bank accounts?
ug2_faq_11_a: Track each bank account as a separate source and balance. Compare statements per account and match transfers as neutral movements between accounts.
ug2_faq_12_q: Will an import damage my existing records?
ug2_faq_12_a: Export first and do not complete an import until validation succeeds. Atomic rollback ensures that a failed import applies no changes.

strategy_nowcast_subtitle: An explainable, time-aware research laboratory for fund return nowcasting
strategy_nowcast_disclaimer: This screen does not provide investment advice or certainty. Live forecasts will only be published when licensed, timestamped data and validation gates are ready.

strategy_nowcast_pipeline_desc: The model is not a single AI score; deterministic contribution, fund specialization, event signals, flows, residual correction and uncertainty are combined.
strategy_nowcast_layer_1_desc: Weight × proxy return, with cash, FX, derivatives, fees and transaction costs separated.
strategy_nowcast_layer_2_desc: Equity, gold, money-market, debt and foreign-asset behavior are modeled separately.
strategy_nowcast_layer_3_desc: Disclosure text produces a bounded, explainable event adjustment—not a raw return percentage.
strategy_nowcast_layer_4_desc: Share count, AUM and investor changes are separated from market-value effects where possible.
strategy_nowcast_layer_5_desc: Machine learning corrects the base nowcast error rather than predicting NAV directly.
strategy_nowcast_layer_6_desc: Point estimates are accompanied by lower/upper bounds, confidence and coverage.
strategy_nowcast_guardrail_1: Data with available_time after prediction_cutoff cannot be used.
strategy_nowcast_guardrail_2: NAV date, publication date and TEFAS reflection date remain separate.
strategy_nowcast_guardrail_3: Out-of-sample comparisons use last-NAV, category-median and weighted-nowcast benchmarks.
strategy_nowcast_guardrail_4: Unknown portfolio exposure and stale data widen the forecast interval.
strategy_nowcast_guardrail_5: No live publication occurs before data licensing and redistribution rights are verified.
